raw_response: {"diagnosis": "From batch 3 onward, about 25% of each batch's transactions arrive 2–3 days after txn_ts. The silver step's hard-coded `ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 HOUR` filter silently drops these late arrivals. txn_id is unique across all 4814 rows, so they are not duplicates. They appear to be legitimate late-delivered transactions that belong in silver and gold, though this assumes the 26-hour cutoff was not an intended business rule.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.65, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1"}}
